skills.name: app-spec-designer

skills.name: brainstorming

skills.name: customer-journey-map

skills.name: design-clone-skill

skills.name: docx

skills.name: epic-breakdown-advisor

skills.name: epic-hypothesis

skills.name: general-video

skills.name: hallmark

skills.name: hyperframes-core

skills.name: hyperframes-creative
skills.description: 负责视频的配色、字体、叙事节拍、品牌风格、声音与画面构图方向。

skills.name: hyperframes-registry

skills.name: jobs-to-be-done

skills.name: lean-ux-canvas

skills.name: motion-graphics

skills.name: opportunity-solution-tree

skills.name: pdf

skills.name: positioning-statement

skills.name: pptx

skills.name: slideshow
